HYPOTHESIS (Zero fragment output / black inputs): Executed RTV draw calls prove command invocation, not non-zero pixel writes. The PS overrides may be reading unbound/black SRVs (t0..tn), zeroed Constant Buffers (b0..bn), or the second alternating draw may overwrite the first draw's output with black.
